from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in comp)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in comp)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in comp)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in comp)
            if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
                continue
            perimeter = set()
            for x in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                perimeter.add((r0, x))
                perimeter.add((r1, x))
            for y in range(r0, r1 + 1):
                perimeter.add((y, c0))
                perimeter.add((y, c1))
            if set(comp) != perimeter:
                continue
            inner_h, inner_w = r1 - r0 - 1, c1 - c0 - 1
            fill = 2 if inner_h % 2 == 0 and inner_w % 2 == 0 else 7
            for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
